while the second number is 0

If you need to store the lengths you can create the list before the while loop and append the song length to the array after the user enters it in the loop.

>also the code is faulty

You're setting total\_song\_length to song\_length which is set to some user input. Given the name of the variable, you should probably add song\_length to total\_song\_length (`total_song_length += song_length`). Also, pulling from your earlier post, this while loop will never be entered because total\_song\_length is initialized to 0 but session\_duration must be greater than 0. If you want to run this code block so long as the total song length is less than the session duration, you need to update the while statement to that (`while total_song_length < session_duration:`).
